description: Field list for per-transport landing observations. Includes selected landing-zone state plus three candidate landing-zone slots.

fields.name: alive
fields.description: 1 if this transport is alive.

fields.name: agent_id_norm
fields.description: Fixed unit identity within the same controllable unit type, normalized to (0, 1].

fields.name: group_slot_norm
fields.description: Slot index of this unit inside the active task group, normalized to (0, 1]; 0 when unassigned.

fields.name: lat_norm
fields.description: Transport latitude normalized by scenario bounds.

fields.name: lon_norm
fields.description: Transport longitude normalized by scenario bounds.

fields.name: is_busy
fields.description: 1 if the transport is executing a non-idle task.

fields.name: is_stationary
fields.description: 1 if transport speed is at most 1 m/s; unloading requires this state.

fields.name: speed_norm
fields.description: Current transport speed normalized by its configured maximum speed.

fields.name: command_speed_norm
fields.description: Persisted commanded movement speed normalized by maximum speed.

fields.name: has_army
fields.description: 1 if the transport still carries army units.

fields.name: army_landed
fields.description: 1 if the carried army has already landed.

fields.name: unloading
fields.description: 1 while this transport is stationary in its 15-minute whole-manifest unload cycle.

fields.name: unload_remaining_norm
fields.description: Remaining unload time divided by the configured 15-minute duration.

fields.name: cargo_unit_count_norm
fields.description: Fraction of this transport's assigned ground-force manifest still onboard.

fields.name: distance_to_landing_zone_norm
fields.description: Distance to the selected fixed sea-side berth.

fields.name: bearing_to_landing_zone_norm
fields.description: Bearing to the selected fixed sea-side berth.

fields.name: sea_path_distance_norm
fields.description: Shortest valid sea-route distance to the selected berth, normalized.

fields.name: sea_path_reachable
fields.description: 1 if the berth is connected to the transport through navigable sea cells.

fields.name: at_landing_zone
fields.description: 1 if inside both the berth arrival tolerance and shoreline unload radius.

fields.name: nearest_blue_ground_distance_norm
fields.description: Distance to nearest known blue ground force.

fields.name: nearest_blue_ground_bearing_norm
fields.description: Bearing to nearest known blue ground force.

fields.name: nearest_blue_sam_distance_norm
fields.description: Distance to nearest known blue SAM.

fields.name: nearest_blue_sam_bearing_norm
fields.description: Bearing to nearest known blue SAM.

fields.name: nearest_blue_air_distance_norm
fields.description: Distance to nearest known blue aircraft.

fields.name: nearest_blue_air_bearing_norm
fields.description: Bearing to nearest known blue aircraft.

fields.name: known_blue_ground_count_norm
fields.description: Known blue ground force count normalized.

fields.name: known_blue_sam_count_norm
fields.description: Known blue SAM count normalized.

fields.name: available_attack_aircraft_count_norm
fields.description: Available red attack aircraft count normalized.

fields.name: elapsed_ratio
fields.description: Landing task elapsed time normalized.

fields.name: landing_complete
fields.description: 1 if this transport has completed unloading.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_1_exists
fields.description: Slot 1: 1 if this candidate landing zone exists.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_1_selected
fields.description: Slot 1: 1 if this is the currently selected landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_1_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 1: distance from this transport to the candidate landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_1_bearing_norm
fields.description: Slot 1: bearing from this transport to the candidate landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_1_nearest_known_sam_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 1: nearest known SAM distance to this landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_1_nearest_known_blue_ground_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 1: nearest known blue ground force distance to this landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_2_exists
fields.description: Slot 2: 1 if this candidate landing zone exists.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_2_selected
fields.description: Slot 2: 1 if this is the currently selected landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_2_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 2: distance from this transport to the candidate landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_2_bearing_norm
fields.description: Slot 2: bearing from this transport to the candidate landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_2_nearest_known_sam_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 2: nearest known SAM distance to this landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_2_nearest_known_blue_ground_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 2: nearest known blue ground force distance to this landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_3_exists
fields.description: Slot 3: 1 if this candidate landing zone exists.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_3_selected
fields.description: Slot 3: 1 if this is the currently selected landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_3_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 3: distance from this transport to the candidate landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_3_bearing_norm
fields.description: Slot 3: bearing from this transport to the candidate landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_3_nearest_known_sam_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 3: nearest known SAM distance to this landing zone.

fields.name: landing_zone_slot_3_nearest_known_blue_ground_distance_norm
fields.description: Slot 3: nearest known blue ground force distance to this landing zone.

fields.name: task_assigned
fields.description: 1 while this transport belongs to an active landing task.

fields.name: heading_sin
fields.description: Sine of the transport's actual heading reported by AFSIM.

fields.name: heading_cos
fields.description: Cosine of the transport's actual heading reported by AFSIM.

fields.name: last_action_id_norm
fields.description: Last landing action id divided by the largest configured landing action id.
